newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Airport traffic rise led by 11pct cargo surge - ACI.
newsitem.headline: Airport traffic rise led by 11pct cargo surge - ACI.

text.p: World air cargo traffic surged 11.3 percent in April latest figures from the Geneva based Airports Council International show.
"The continued surge in the air cargo market is good news for global economic activity in general," said Maria Hinayon, the ACI manager for statistics and data processing.
"Global passenger growth was impressive in all regions except North America, where the slight blib was largely due to Easter occuring in March in 1977, rather than in April 1996," she added.
The climb in freight and mail traffic to 4.4 million tonnes came in the 496 airports around the world monitored by the ACI
Passenger traffic increased by some 4.7 percent in April 1997 compared with year ago data and aircraft movements rose by 3.5 pecent.

Cargo growth was led by Asia/Pacific and North America which both registered double-digit growth whilst the Middle easat showed the strongest growth in passenger traffic but the total was held back by the modest rise in North America.
